Name: SeasonsOfOrbis
Description: Seasons of Orbis, yearly events for any server running Ziggfreed's CommonLib and RPG Stations: Hallow's Eve with Old Jack from October 1 to November 12 and Harvest Feast with Martha the Cook from November 20 to December 1, each with quests, a daily board and a stall in the Forgotten Temple, plus Hytale's Anniversary every January 13. Festival Favor and Festival Tokens carry over from season to season; MMO Skill Tree is optional and adds skill XP.
